{

RETURN p.name AS CEO, numCompanies",
  "rationale": "Finds all companies where Norman Welsh was ever CEO, then for each of those companies finds any other CEO (excluding Norman). Counts the distinct companies per such CEO and returns the CEO’s name and the count."
}
